about:
Massachusetts Bay Technologies (MBT) was founded in 1999 in Stoughton, Massachusetts. The company began as a specialist in the engineering, manufacture, and distribution of discrete silicon RF and microwave semiconductor devices, single-layer ceramic capacitors, and thin-film products.

MBT produces a range of RF and microwave components, including silicon diodes, ceramic capacitors, and thin-film devices operating from 100 Hz to millimeter-wave frequencies. The company operates its own manufacturing and screening facilities, offering high-reliability testing up to space-level qualifications per MIL‑STD‑19500 and MIL‑STD‑750, with three screening tiers (TX, TXV, and S). Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2008 and includes incoming material inspection, equipment calibration, and a controlled ESD program.

The company serves academic and laboratory research, consumer electronics, telecommunications, military, and space programs. It positions itself as a primary source for hard‑to‑find or obsolete RF and microwave diodes, capacitors, and thin-film parts.

MBT states that its founding purpose was to continue innovation in service to customers, improving design, product performance, and quality control across its product lines.
